desc:
Welcome to HellaVerse RP! 👹 

Roleplay as your favorite Hazbin Hotel and Helluva Boss characters, meet other fans and start your own story in Hell!

🎭  Morph into your favorite characters, and customize them however you want with our variants!
🏨  Explore the Hotel, Heaven's City, Rosie's Emporium, I.M.P. Office, and much more!
✍️  Set your own RP name, Bio and Titles
🆕  New rooms and morphs get release with almost each update!

⭐ Like the game and join our group for free limited morphs:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/34827479/Hazbin-Hotel-Roleplay-Group

🎮 Controller: hold R2 to sprint. VR supported (may have some bugs).

✍️ Server restart = update!

♥️ By KennyIta and Lilek
All credits belong to Vivziepop, SpindleHorse, A24, Amazon and Bento Box Entertainment. Accessory creators can request removal of their items at any time.
